reason: Both satisfy all hard requirements, but B is slightly more practically grounded: it adds a time-to-full growth-rate estimate to drive urgency triage, explicitly handles the edge case of a disk too full to even initiate a snapshot, and its abort/rollback condition is more coherent, tying a concrete recovery action (restore from the already-taken snapshot) to clearly defined trigger conditions. A's rollback logic is good but its abort condition is oddly placed inside MITIGATION despite describing a pre-snapshot scenario that section has already gated past.
